content:wysiwyg_basic:2:53.html: For over 30 years, The Salvation Army Hampton Roads Area Command, with the help of our community partners and donors, has worked to ensure that children in Hampton Roads start the new school year with the “Write Stuff." The Write Stuff back-to-school initiative is an annual event that distributes backpacks filled with school supplies to students in grades K through 12 who reside in Norfolk, Chesapeake, Virginia Beach, Portsmouth, Suffolk, and Western Tidewater.

content:wysiwyg_basic:5:71.html:
2026 WRITE Stuff distribution information

The Salvation Army is helping local K–12 students get ready for the new school year with our Write Stuff Backpack Distribution. We’ll Be providing free backpacks filled with school supplies to students in need — while supplies last!

Distribution Locations & Dates

Kroc Center Hampton Roads

1401 Ballentine Blvd, Norfolk, VA

August 14, 2026 | 4:00 pm to 7:00 pm

August 15, 2026 | 9:00 am to 12 Noon

Our Kroc Center distribution is open to residents of Norfolk, Chesapeake, and Virginia Beach

Portsmouth Corps

2306 Airline Blvd, Portsmouth, VA

August 14, 2026 | 4:00 pm to 7:00 pm

Our Portsmouth Corps distribution is open to residents of Portsmouth (any zip code) and Chesapeake residents living in zip codes 23321 and 23323 only

Suffolk Corps

400 Bank St, Suffolk, VA

August 8, 2026 | 10:00 am to 12 Noon

Our Suffolk Corps distribution is open to residents of Suffolk and Western Tidewater

Required Documentation

Valid government-issued photo ID for parent or guardian (not expired)

Proof of residency

Child’s Birth certificate

For more information, please call the Hampton Roads Area Command at 757-543-8100 or scan the qr code on the flyer.

Download Flyer Here

You can support this important fundraiser by becoming a sponsor, making a donation, or dropping off school supplies. To donate supplies or participate in a supply donation drive, please contact:
Beth Hornby | beth.hornby@uss.salvationarmy.org | 757-271-8431
